title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where exactly should you place a stop-loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss takes more thought than whether to use one at all. Place it too close and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far away and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-percentage method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward—good for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other traders’ stop-losses.

【Technical-level stop-loss method】Place it where the market structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if the price breaks through this level, it’s evidence that I was wrong.
Work backward from your position size: the wider the stop, the smaller the position, so the loss on any single trade stays at

📰 Why is Circle minting $250 million in USDC on Solana at a loss?

Circle minted 250 million USDC on the Solana blockchain, directly boosting liquidity on the network. This may be an effort to stimulate Solana network activity and adoption, but the market remains cautious about whether such a large issuance can bring a lasting price rally.

Why does this news matter?
The underlying reason for this issuance is that the Solana ecosystem is currently facing shrinking network activity and stagnant adoption. By injecting a large amount of stablecoins into the market, Circle is trying to break this deadlock and make Solana a more attractive option for institutional and individual users. This aligns with the broader crypto market’s recent shift from a FOMO-driven mood toward more rational evaluation—rather than simply chasing hot sectors, investors are looking for tangible improvements in infrastructure. This means the Solana ecosystem is trying to offset weak demand with a boost to supply.

Market impact
The direct impact on BTC and ETH prices is minimal; the movements of these two major cryptocurrencies are influenced more by macroeconomic conditions and regulatory sentiment. But the real significance of this news lies in what it could reveal about Solana’s ecosystem strategy: if the issuance effectively boosts network activity (for example, by improving metrics such as DEX trading volume and the number of staking addresses), it could attract some users who are sensitive to Ethereum gas fees to Solana, potentially driving up the price of SOL. Historically, similar events, such as Binance’s early USDC issuances, did push up the price of BNB in the short term, but the ultimate impact depends on whether Solana can build a sustainable ecosystem flywheel.

Trading outlook
💡 If SOL can hold above $109.55 in the short term following Circle’s move, alongside substantial growth in on-chain activity, it may indicate that the Solana ecosystem is finding a breakthrough point and is worth watching. But if SOL falls below $109.55 and DEX trading volume and active addresses remain sluggish, this view no longer holds.

📰 为何 Circle 在 Solana 赤字狂印 2.5 亿美元 USDC？

Circle 在 Solana 区块链上增发 2.5 亿枚 USDC，直接推高该网络的流动性。这可能是为了刺激 Solana 的网络活动和采用率，但市场对这类大幅增发能否带来持久价格涨势仍持谨慎态度。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次增发背后的根本原因，是 Solana 生态目前面临网络活动萎缩和采用率停滞的困境。通过向市场注入大量稳定币，Circle 试图打破这种僵局，让 Solana 成为一个对机构和个人用户更有吸引力的选择。这与近期币圈整体从 FOMO 氛围转向理性评估的周期相符——不再是单纯追高热门赛道，而是看基础设施的实质性改善。这意味着 Solana 生态正在尝试用供应端的发力，来弥补需求端的疲软。

对市场的影响
对 BTC/ETH 价格的直接影响微乎其微，这两大主流币的波动更多受宏观宏观经济和监管情绪影响。但这条新闻的真正价值在于验证 Solana 的生态战略：如果增发能有效提振网络活跃度（比如 DEX 交易量、Stake 地址数等指标改善），可能会吸引部分对以太坊 Gas 费用敏感的用户转向 Solana，从而带动 SOL 价格。历史上类似事件，比如币安早期的 USDC 增发，确实在短期内推高了 BNB 价格，但最终效果取决于 Solana 能否形成可持续的生态闭环。

操作思路
💡 Circle 的这波操作，如果 SOL 价格能在短期内站稳 $109.55 美元，并出现链上活动数据的实质性增长，可能意味着 Solana 生态正在找到突破点，值得关注。但如果 SOL 跌破 $109.55，且 DEX 交易量和活跃地址数继续萎靡，这个判断作废。

如果 Solana 网络费用大幅上涨或出现新的技术故障，这个判断作废。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

translatedData.title: Long and short sentiment is hidden in funding rates: Learn to read three typical states
translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, let’s talk about how to use them as a sentiment thermometer.

[State 1: Funding rates stay strongly positive] This means longs are crowded, and everyone is borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and could plunge sharply at any moment in a long squeeze. I’m not telling you to immediately
short; rather, be especially cautious about chasing longs at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates stay negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who needed to get out has already done so, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past have started at times like these.

Cambridge post-quantum workshop schedule | ETH holds above 2500, but no upgrade has been implemented | Don’t chase before 2517

My stance is cautiously bullish, but I don’t mistake a research meeting for a mainnet upgrade. Ethereum’s official post-quantum research website lists the agenda for the second Cambridge workshop, scheduled for October 10–12. Topics on October 11 include constrained signatures, threshold signatures, and recursive proof security; October 12 also features “Ethereum PQ integration.” The ethereum.org roadmap page lists this Cambridge research event as well. What’s confirmed here is the public agenda—not that the topics have produced final results, and certainly not that post-quantum features are already live on mainnet.

This is worth traders’ attention, but the path to market impact is long. If account signatures and proof systems can gradually become more resilient to quantum attacks, that could help reduce long-term uncertainty around asset security and network migration. At the same time, new approaches must address verification costs, transaction size, wallet compatibility, audits, and community consensus. Until these issues are addressed with technically verifiable solutions and an upgrade timeline, a workshop cannot be directly translated into additional ETH cash flows or short-term buying pressure. Following the research direction doesn’t mean paying a premium for the news.

The market’s existing reaction should also be interpreted cautiously. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,507, slightly above the day’s open at $2,504. The 24-hour low was $2,489.79 and the high was $2,516.65. The price is holding above 2,500 for now, but has yet to break the 24-hour high. So I see 2,500 as a sentiment threshold, 2,517 as the breakout confirmation level, and 2,489–2,490 as the support zone. The fact that the price action coincides with the workshop does not prove that the meeting drove the rise. If ETH falls below 2,489 and fails to recover, or if subsequent official materials show that the research is difficult to turn into an implementable solution, I’ll withdraw my current bullish view.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase based on the agenda; I’d only consider a small spot long, with no high leverage. I’d only use 2% of my total capital to test an entry if ETH breaks above 2,517, closes above it for two consecutive one-hour candles, and holds that level on a retest. If those conditions aren’t met, I’d stay out. The first target is 2,540, where I’d take half off; the second is 2,580, with the rest closed proactively if the hourly candle falls back below 2,517. I’d set a hard stop at 2,485 and exit immediately if it’s hit—no averaging down. If ETH first drops below 2,489, the entire breakout plan is off; I’d wait for a new structure rather than try to pick a bottom.

Sources: Ethereum’s official post-quantum workshop agenda, the ethereum.org post-quantum roadmap page, and live ETH/USD prices on Kraken. #EthereumSurpasses2500USDT #ETH

This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是审慎偏多，不把研究会议当成主网升级。以太坊官方抗量子研究网站列出10月10日至12日的剑桥第二届研讨会议程；10月11日安排受约束签名、门限签名、递归证明安全等议题，12日还有“Ethereum PQ integration”。ethereum.org路线页面也列出这次剑桥研究活动。这里核实的是公开议程，并非议题已有最终成果，更不是抗量子功能已经上主网。

这件事值得交易员留意，但传导路径很长。账户签名与证明系统若能逐步提高抗量子韧性，长期有助于减少资产安全和网络迁移的不确定性；同时新方案要面对验证成本、交易大小、钱包兼容、审计与社区共识。只要这些问题没有得到可复核的技术方案和升级时间表，就不能把一场研讨直接折算成ETH的新增现金流或短期买盘。关注研究方向，不等于为消息付溢价。

市场已有的反应也要克制解读。截稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2507美元，略高于当日开盘2504，过去24小时低点2489.79、高点2516.65；价格暂时守在2500上方，却尚未越过24小时高点。因此我把2500看作情绪分界，把2517看作突破验证位，2489—2490看作下方防守区。价格表现与会议同时出现，不足以证明上涨由会议驱动。若跌破2489并持续不能收回，或后续官方材料表明研究难以转化为可实施方案，当前偏多判断就要撤回。

如果是我自己交易，此刻不会因议程追单；方向只考虑现货小仓位做多，不开高杠杆。仅在ETH突破2517且连续两根一小时K线收在其上、回踩仍守住时，才动用总资金的2%试仓；若没有触发就保持空仓。第一目标2540，到了先减一半；第二目标2580，余仓以小时线跌回2517作为主动平仓信号。硬止损放在2485，触及立即平仓，不摊低成本。若先跌穿2489，整套突破计划作废，等新结构而非猜底。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts.
The two sides pay each other; the exchange only collects and distributes the money—it doesn’t profit from it.

【How it works】Perpetual contracts have no expiration date, so how does their price stay in line with the spot price? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
The money flows back and forth between both sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#ETH #Gas #BTC

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Is the Fuel Money of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay Gas fees to transfer tokens or mint an NFT. Who does that money go to?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring tokens, trading, running
contracts) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who execute those computations for you.
“Fuel money.” The more congested the network, the more everyone rushes to execute transactions, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → soaring Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operations can cost half as much.

【The mistake retail investors make most often: seeing ETH cut in half and thinking it’s time to buy the dip】

When people see ETH fall nearly 50% from its peak, they start thinking: “At this price, it must be about right, doesn’t it?”

But after watching the market over the past few months, I want to say this: the problem isn’t how far prices have fallen—it’s whether liquidity has returned.

October marks the first anniversary of that flash crash. The order book depth for BTC and ETH is indeed greater now than it was back then—institutions have returned as market makers, which is a good thing. But what about altcoins? Liquidity is still draining away, and there’s no one stepping in to buy.

ETH is now stuck around 2,500, fluctuating between 2,444 and 2,566. It’s down 7% over the past seven days, and trading volume hasn’t picked up, which suggests the market is waiting on the sidelines. This kind of sideways trading is frustrating, but it’s often a precursor to a major move.

What I really can’t figure out isn’t the price, but the structure behind it: liquidity has returned, but who’s using it? Are institutions back to swing trading? If they are, are they building positions or just trading for the short term?

I’ve also been keeping an eye on the Ledger incident. A hardware wallet manufacturer has had a security issue. More and more assets are on-chain, but ordinary people’s ability to keep them safe hasn’t kept pace. What does this mean for ETH’s on-chain ecosystem—is it an opportunity for hardware wallets, or will the entire industry be forced to raise its security standards?

My current view is that ETH isn’t particularly risky at this level, but we need to wait for confirmation of the market structure before calling it an opportunity. Don’t rush to conclusions. What’s really worth thinking about this time is: after the correction, what kinds of assets will truly benefit?

ETH｜SEC approves listing rules for a 3x Ether product｜Daily leveraged returns are not spot net inflows

My view: This is a regulatory development worth unpacking, but it is not a reason for me to chase ETH. On October 2, the U.S. SEC approved a proposed rule change submitted by Cboe BZX to list and trade products including the 3x Ether ETF under VS Trust. The filing says the product seeks, before fees, to deliver three times the benchmark’s “daily” performance. The benchmark primarily tracks specified front-month and second-month Ether futures, and the fund intends to use futures and cash-like collateral to achieve its objective. Approval of the rule does not mean the product has already been listed or has received new creations—much less that the spot market has seen three times as many ETH buy orders today.

The easiest thing to overlook is path dependence. Suppose the benchmark rises 10% on day one and falls about 9.09% on day two, returning to its starting point over the two days. In theory, a daily 3x product would first rise 30%, then fall about 27.27%, leaving it below its starting point—and that is before fees, roll costs, and trading costs. This is only an arithmetic example, not a prediction of the fund’s future net asset value. The SEC filing also distinguishes commodity trust shares with “ETF” in their names as ETPs; they are not structured the same way as ordinary funds regulated under the Investment Company Act of 1940. Investors who focus only on the words “3x Ether” can easily mistake a daily target for a long-term threefold return.

The market has not provided evidence that this old filing has driven a one-way rise in spot ETH. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,503, trading between about $2,493.49 and $2,516.65 over the past 24 hours and continuing to oscillate around $2,500. U.S. spot ETH ETF flow data through October 9 still showed net outflows. There was no U.S. fund trading session over the weekend, so a return in market prices to around $2,500 should not be described as ETF flows having reversed. In the short term, I’m watching whether $2,517 can hold decisively. If ETH falls back below $2,493 and fails to rebound, the bullish thesis is invalidated. Regulatory approval expands product choice, but it does not erase the differences between spot, futures, and leveraged daily resets.

If I were trading this myself: I would not trade the 3x product or add to my position just because the listing rules were approved; I would only consider a small spot long. I would enter a test position using 2% of my total capital only if ETH’s one-hour candle closes above $2,517 and a pullback holds near $2,510. My first target would be $2,540, where I would sell half; I’d hold the rest for $2,565. I would place the initial stop below $2,492. If the pullback breaks below $2,500, or the next ETF flow report worsens and price cannot reclaim $2,517, I would close the position. If none of these conditions is met, I would wait rather than gamble on a policy headline with high leverage.

Sources: SEC Release No. 34-106577; Farside daily ETH fund data; live Kraken ETH/USD quotes. #ETH

This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH｜SEC批准三倍以太产品上市规则｜日收益杠杆不是现货净流入

我的态度：这是一条值得拆解的监管信息，但不构成我追买ETH的理由。美国SEC于10月2日批准Cboe BZX为VS Trust旗下3x Ether ETF等产品提交的上市交易规则变更。文件说明，该产品寻求在扣除费用前实现基准“单日”表现的三倍；基准主要看指定的近月及次近月以太期货，基金拟用期货及现金类抵押品实现目标。批准规则不等于确认产品已经挂牌、已收到新申购，更不等于现货市场今天多了三倍ETH买单。

最容易被忽略的是路径依赖。假设基准首日涨10%、次日跌约9.09%，两日回到起点；每日三倍产品理论上先涨30%、再跌约27.27%，结果仍低于起点，且实际还要扣除费用、展期和交易成本。这只是算术示例，不是对该基金未来净值的预测。SEC文件还把名字带“ETF”的这类商品信托份额区分为ETP，与普通受1940年投资公司法监管的基金并非同一结构。投资者若仅看“三倍以太”四个字，很容易把单日目标误当长期三倍收益。

市场目前没有给出这份旧文件带动现货ETH单边上涨的证据。撰文时Kraken ETH/USD约2503美元，过去24小时约2493.49至2516.65美元，仍围绕2500反复。美国ETH现货ETF资金表截至10月9日继续显示净流出，周末没有新的美国基金交易日，因此不能把场内价格回到2500附近写成ETF资金已经转向。短线我观察2517是否有效站稳；若跌回2493以下且反抽失败，偏强假设失效。监管通过提高产品选择，却未消除现货、期货和杠杆重置之间的差异。

如果是我自己交易：不参与三倍产品，也不因上市规则批准直接加仓；方向仅限现货轻仓多头。只有ETH一小时收盘高于2517、回踩2510附近企稳，我才用总资金2%试单，目标先看2540，到位减半，剩余看2565；初始止损放在2492下方。若回踩跌穿2500，或下一次ETF资金数据继续恶化且价格无法站回2517，就平仓；没有触发就等待，不借高杠杆赌政策标题。

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.title: Why Is USDT Pegged to $1? How Stablecoins Work
translatedData.subTitle:
USDT is essential for trading futures, but many people have never thought about why it is worth $1.

【How it works】A stablecoin is operated by its issuer: you give it $1, and it gives you 1 USDT, while depositing
the dollars (and equivalent assets) into its reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can request redemption from the issuer
for redemption. This “mint-and-redeem” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price near $1.
The price may occasionally deviate slightly (for example, to $0.999), but arbitrageurs quickly bring it back in line.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Being Flat Is a Position Too—and the One Experienced Traders Use Most Often
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly going in and out,
until fees and volatility slowly eat away their capital.

In reality, staying flat is the only position with “zero losses.” If you can’t make sense of the market, stay flat,
Staying out when bulls and bears are locked in a tug-of-war, and staying out after a few consecutive bad trades—the money you save in these moments,
is more than most people make from trading.

We’ve all heard the hunting analogy, but it’s true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just one second. If you have capital, you’ll have ammunition when an opportunity comes along. Hold on to your ammunition.

My stance is cautious: $2,500 looks more like a boundary that bulls and bears are repeatedly testing than a level where a single touch can prove a new trend is underway. The current Binance Square topic, #EthereumSurpasses2500USDT, describes a move above the round-number level; it doesn’t guarantee that ETH is still holding above it now. At the time of writing, ETH/USD’s latest trade on Kraken was around $2,499, with a 24-hour range of approximately $2,493 to $2,517. In other words, the market has already moved above the level, pulled back, and approached it again. Calling a single touch a confirmed breakout would base a plan on an outdated price.

Flows also don’t support chasing the price based on hype alone. Farside’s daily table shows that U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net outflows for nine consecutive trading days, from September 29 through October 9, totaling approximately $56.1 million on October 9 alone. These are historical flow figures that have already been reported, not real-time weekend redemptions. A weekend rebound in the spot price does not contradict the earlier ETF outflows. ETF creations and redemptions affect marginal demand through institutional channels on business days, while weekend spot and derivatives trading can still push the price above a round-number level. The two signals should be viewed separately: a price breakout indicates short-term buying has emerged, while sustained net outflows suggest that follow-through demand has yet to be confirmed.

The key levels I’m watching are $2,500, the 24-hour high of $2,517, and the low of $2,493. If ETH can stabilize above $2,500 and break above $2,517 with increased volume, I’ll consider this pullback a potential continuation. If it repeatedly fails to hold $2,493, the breakout thesis is invalidated. Don’t treat these levels as guaranteed support or resistance; they’re simply recent reference points that can be checked. If ETF data on the next U.S. trading day turns to net inflows, that would improve the flow picture. If outflows continue, I’ll be less inclined to chase, even if there’s a brief weekend spike.

If I were trading this myself, I’d stay out for now. I’d only consider a small, trend-following long position—not a bottom-fishing trade. Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (execution),

🤔 How did Specter trace the full path taken by the Ledger attacker to move nearly 30 million ETH?

After hardware wallet maker Ledger was hit, the hacker didn’t disappear with the stolen funds. Instead, they deposited nearly 30 million ETH into the DeFi cryptocurrency exchange Tornado Cash. Specter, a wallet-tracking investigator, found that the funds had first been sent to 14 temporary addresses, then moved cross-chain to the ZEC network using a different method, and finally hidden away. The operation was pretty complex, but Specter still managed to recover most of the funds.

Why is this news important?
This news is important because it reveals a common money-laundering tactic in crypto crime: first conceal funds using hardware wallets, then obscure their trail through various methods. The nearly 30 million ETH involved in this incident was worth about $7.45. The hacker’s steps included splitting the funds across multiple addresses, moving them cross-chain, and then transferring them to Tornado Cash. This makes recovering the funds more difficult and forces regulators to consider how to better track the flow of illicit money. Tornado Cash is also a well-known privacy-focused DeFi platform, and funds sent there are typically seeking to be anonymized.

Market impact
From a market perspective, the incident may have limited direct impact on BTC or ETH prices, since the amount of ETH involved is not especially large relative to the overall market. However, if this method becomes widespread, it could make the market more anonymous and weaken regulators’ ability to trace illicit funds. This means similar fund-transfer methods may become more common in the future, and regulators will need to continually adjust their strategies to address them.

Trading outlook
💡 This incident may have a slight effect on market sentiment, but it won’t change the overall trend. If ETH can hold the $2.45 level, the market may not be significantly affected in the short term; but if it falls below that level, it could spark more concerns about where funds are flowing. This view would no longer apply if regulators begin tightening oversight of privacy-focused DeFi platforms such as Tornado Cash.

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月十一日下午六时，以太坊现货报价两千四百九十九美元，过去二十四小时内小幅上涨百分之零点二七，价格在两千五百美元整数关口附近反复拉锯。从小时K线来看，最近五个交易时段以太坊在两千四百九十七美元至两千五百零八美元之间窄幅波动，振幅不足十美元，市场观望情绪浓厚。

均线系统方面，七小时均线报两千五百零三点，二十五小时均线报两千五百零六点，九十九小时均线报两千五百一十四美元。短期均线全部位于长期均线下方，呈现空头排列格局。价格目前运行在所有主要均线下方，短期偏弱态势明显。值得注意的是，九十九小时均线自两千五百三十二美元持续下行至两千五百一十四美元，中长期均线拐头向下的趋势尚未扭转。

布林带上轨两千五百一十五美元，中轨两千五百零六美元，下轨两千四百九十八美元。价格运行在布林带中下轨之间，接近下轨支撑。抛物线指标报两千五百一十美元，位于当前价格上方，维持看空信号。超级趋势指标稳定在两千四百九十四美元，为短期提供了关键支撑位。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标方面，MACD线报零点二六，信号线报一点四零，柱状图为负一点一四。虽然柱状图绝对值较前一时期略有收窄，但MACD线与信号线之间的差距依然较大，空头动能尚未完全衰竭。需要关注的是，MACD柱状图已连续五个时段维持负值，从负一点零七扩大至负一点一四后小幅回落，空头趋势出现边际减弱迹象。

RSI指标显示，六周期RSI报四十四点六，十二周期RSI报四十七点八，二十四周期RSI报四十八点二，均处于五十下方偏弱区域。短周期RSI此前一度跌至三十九附近，接近超卖区域后有所反弹，显示低位存在一定买盘承接。

KDJ指标处于明显超卖区域，K值二十七点四，D值二十九点三，J值二十三点六。三线均运行在三十附近低位区域，J值此前一度跌至十六点四的极端低位后小幅回升，超卖反弹信号初现。威廉指标报负七十三点八，深入超卖区域，与KDJ指标形成共振，暗示短期存在技术性反弹的可能。

从量化因子来看，十五个因子中九个看多、五个看空、一个中性，多头因子占比达到百分之六十，明显优于比特币的多空均衡格局。然而综合指标仍发出短线看空信号，整体胜率约百分之六十八点一，历史回测显示该信号在以太坊上的准确性较高。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前呈现出技术面偏弱但链上数据向好的矛盾格局。从利好因素来看，鲸鱼地址在市场回调期间大幅增持超过十六万六千枚以太坊，有效吸收了流通抛压，将价格锚定在两千四百九十美元上方。交易所净流入数据显示，近期持续出现正向净流入，峰值达到两千六百七十万美元，为价格反弹提供了资金支撑。此外，短期EMA七上穿EMA二十五一度形成金叉信号，提振了部分技术派交易者的信心。

从利空因素来看，以太坊现货ETF已经连续九天遭遇净流出，累计流出约五点四二亿美元，创下一月份以来最差单周表现，机构投资者的持续撤退对价格构成显著压制。价格始终无法有效突破九十九周期均线两千五百三十一美元的压制，上方阻力沉重。同时，硬件钱包供应链安全事件也对整体市场情绪产生了一定负面影响。

从生态层面来看，StarkNet宣布计划从以太坊二层网络转型为独立一层链，相关代币STRK单日暴涨百分之五十四，反映出市场对以太坊生态变革的高度关注。Aerodrome与Velodrome宣布合并为跨链去中心化交易所，将于十月二十一日上线，有望为以太坊生态注入新的流动性。

综合来看，以太坊短期在两千五百美元关口面临多空激烈争夺。KDJ和威廉指标双双进入超卖区域，技术性反弹条件逐步成熟。上方关键阻力位于两千五百一十至两千五百三十美元区间，若能有效突破，有望打开向两千六百美元运行的空间。下方支撑关注两千四百九十四美元的超级趋势线。建议投资者关注ETF资金流向变化及超卖反弹信号，逢低适度布局，严格设置止损。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | The five rules I keep posted beside my screen, shared exactly as they are today
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every principle, so I wrote these down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can't, don't enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position. Never average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don't trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. What you take out is money; what you leave behind is your mindset.

Just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market; it's that their execution fell apart. Here's to us.

When good news fails to lift prices, that’s weakness. On-chain whales are buying, but ETF money is flowing out. I trust the money, not the wallets.

The primary scenario is bearish. Until BTC can reclaim 85,000, treat every bounce as a chance to reduce exposure. If the weekly close is above 85,000 and ETFs turn to net inflows, I’ll admit I was wrong and drop this scenario.

BTC spot ETFs saw net outflows of $678.9 million this week, and funding rates lean bearish. My approach: 84,500–85,000 is a zone for bears to act; set a stop above 85,500. If 80,500 breaks, add to bearish positions, with 80,000 as the first target.

ETH: Currently at 2,499.95, having just fallen below the 2,500 psychological level and the 50-day moving average. Whales have accumulated about 166,000 ETH over the past 72 hours, but institutions are pulling out. My approach: if a rebound to 2,550–2,600 fails, that’s a short entry; a break below 2,450 confirms weakness, with 2,330 as the next downside target. SOL: Currently at 109.27, already below 110. SkyAI transferred about $115 million worth of SOL to exchanges over three days, leaving potential selling pressure overhead. On-chain sentiment is near rock bottom, but without a narrative to support it, a bottom is just a sideways market. My approach: no directional trades. Don’t take a long position on a SOL rebound; the $115 million transfer hasn’t been absorbed. Chasing STRK at the current price offers a terrible risk-reward ratio. Leveraged dip-buying around 2,500 in ETH is just handing money to liquidations.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their money in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12 times your money over 250 trading days in a year; at a steady 10% a month,
you’d have 30 times your money after three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. You wait for market opportunities, but discipline is yours. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market;
the ability behind the latter is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

In recent years, quite a few of the country’s leading companies have fallen into a trap of “overprotection,” gradually losing the flexibility they need to compete in the market.

On the one hand, they face competitive pressure from external markets; on the other, they are subject to indiscriminate support, preferential allocation of resources, and administrative intervention.

At the top, there is not enough free competition for companies to be selected or eliminated through genuine market forces. At the bottom, there is not enough respect for market demand, so consumers’ choices and feedback cannot effectively determine which companies survive.

When companies no longer need to prove their worth through continuous innovation, greater efficiency, and better products, and instead grow accustomed to relying on policy, resources, and barriers to competition to maintain their advantage, protection gradually turns into a form of institutional inertia.

The real question is not whether to support companies, but whether they are still allowed to fail after receiving that support.

A healthy business environment should not guarantee that companies survive forever; it should ensure that the market always has the ability to weed out those that fall behind.

Otherwise, what emerges may not be a group of leading companies that can compete globally, but a group of huge organizations that struggle to survive independently without policy protection.

They may look enormous, but their competitiveness is fragile. They may seem to dominate the market, but in reality they are moving further and further away from it.

Protection can help companies weather a downturn. But if it replaces competition, then by the time the downturn is over, companies may have lost the ability to survive on their own.

That’s why Huawei is so used to doubling down. Even when a brake pedal breaks, it can still say, “There’s nothing wrong with my product; it fully complies with national standards.”

In recent years, the overprotective policies toward “leading companies” in the No. 1 Central Documents have emboldened them. Huawei and other leading companies often use administrative influence to manage public relations around the most basic quality issues.

Some users and bloggers who voice their concerns are even threatened with lawyers’ letters or have their accounts banned across the internet… What an absurd system.

$BTC $ETH #btc #ETH

content:
国内不少头部企业，近些年正在陷入一种“过度保护”的困境，最终逐渐失去市场竞争所需要的灵活性。

一方面，它们面临外部市场的竞争压力，另一方面，内部又存在盲目扶持、资源倾斜和行政力量干预。

向上，缺乏充分的自由竞争，企业很难在真正的市场竞争中完成优胜劣汰，向下，又缺乏对市场需求的充分尊重，消费者的选择和反馈无法有效决定企业的生死。

当企业不再需要通过持续创新、提升效率和改善产品来证明自己的价值，而是习惯于依赖政策、资源和市场壁垒维持优势时，保护就会逐渐演变成一种制度性惰性。

真正的问题不是扶持企业，而是扶持之后，是否还允许它失败。

一个健康的商业环境，不应该保证企业永远活着，而应该保证市场始终有能力淘汰落后的企业。

否则，最终诞生的可能不是一批具有全球竞争力的头部企业，而是一批离开政策保护就难以独立生存的庞大组织。

它们看起来规模庞大，实际上竞争力脆弱，看起来占据市场，实际上正在远离市场。

保护可以帮助企业度过寒冬，但如果保护取代了竞争，寒冬结束之后，企业可能已经失去了独立生存的能力。

所以华为很习惯的嘴硬，刹车踏板断裂，也能说“我没问题，完全符合国标”。

近几年一号文件对“头部企业”过度保护政策给了他们底气，除了某为还有其他的头部企业经常通过行政力量公关最基本的质量问题。

甚至一些反馈的用户、博主、还会被律师函警告、全网封号……离谱的制度。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What does the candlestick you FOMO into usually look like?
translatedData.subTitle:
The price shoots up in a big bullish candle, everyone in the group is yelling “Buy!”, and you nervously chase in—only to end up buying at
the very top. This scenario plays out every day.

Take a close look at the big bullish candle that gets your heart racing: it’s what people who are already fully invested hope you’ll chase in to take off their hands.
After a sharp, high-volume rally, chasing in is essentially providing liquidity to those who got in earlier.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback comes on lower volume and stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you your principal back a second time.

Ethereum Transaction Outcome Verification｜ETH Around $2,499｜I’m Not Treating the Proposal as a Realized Bullish Catalyst

My stance is to pay attention to the security design, but not to chase this news in the short term. On October 5, the Ethereum Foundation discussed “native transaction assertions”: a signature confirms a call request, but does not guarantee that the resulting balance, authorization, or contract state will match the user’s intent. The article presents EIP-7906 as one possible approach: read-only checks at the end of a transaction would inspect net state changes, and execution would revert if preset conditions are not met. The proposal page is still marked Draft, and the Foundation has also said the design is still in progress. It should not be described as already enabled on Ethereum mainnet, let alone as making signature risks disappear.

There is a more important caveat here than “yet another EIP”: pre-transaction simulations can only predict outcomes based on the chain state at that moment, which may change before the transaction is actually included on-chain. Outcome verification could check conditions such as a minimum amount received or the scope of an authorization at the end of execution. But assertions must come from independent user intent or established wallet policies. If a compromised frontend also supplies the rules, a malicious transaction could still be allowed through. Reverting does not mean it is free; a failed transaction still consumes gas. I’ll be watching for a finalized specification, client implementations, whether wallets require assertions, and audit and testnet results—not just the proposal’s headline.

Its impact on ETH is more likely to be medium- to long-term: reducing mistaken signatures and execution discrepancies could increase institutions’ and everyday users’ trust in on-chain operations. But the path from research to widespread wallet adoption is long, and it will not immediately generate ETH buying. At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,499, with an opening price of $2,504 and a rolling 24-hour high of $2,517 and low of $2,491; the current price is near the bottom of that range. Price action cannot be attributed to this research article from six days ago. I’m watching $2,517 as a confirmation level above and $2,491 as the breakdown level below. I’ll revise my cautious view if wallets implement this in practice and capital-flow data improves; if the price breaks below the lower boundary and ETF outflows continue, I’ll take a more defensive stance.

If I were trading this myself, I’d sit out for now and keep only a conditional plan for a leveraged-free spot long. If ETH moves back above $2,517 and holds that level on a retest, I’d use no more than 3% of my total funds to test a long position. The first target is $2,580; at that level, I’d take half off and move the stop-loss on the remainder to around the entry price. I’d close the rest near the second target of $2,640. If the price falls back below $2,490 after entry, I’d stop out immediately. If it breaks below $2,491 first, I’ll stay flat rather than try to catch a falling knife against the trend based on a security narrative. The proposal is a fact; its adoption and price impact still need to be verified. If the conditions aren’t triggered, there’s no trade.

Keep these points in mind about the Cancun upgrade and blobs:
1) When the Cancun upgrade went live, the target was 3 blobs per block, with a maximum of 6; the Pectra upgrade in May 2025 raised this to a target of 6 and a maximum of 9.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Deceiving You While You Hold on to a Losing Position
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on paper focus on? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it just gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Pay attention: that thought is pure attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand right now.

Once you’re stuck holding a position, you automatically seek out good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple in theory, but hard to do: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the thesis for this trade
would be invalidated,” then act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decision-making from holding the position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value across a hundred trades. Next time your hand shakes as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

ETH funds see net outflows for nine consecutive trading days | Current price around $2,499 | I don’t treat a weekend rebound as a return of inflows

I’m leaning cautious. I’ll wait for funds and price action to confirm each other, rather than chase the back-and-forth around $2,500. The current trending topic on Binance Square is #EtherETFsExtendOutflowsToNineDays. Binance News cites SoSoValue, which says U.S. spot Ethereum funds saw net outflows of about $542.1 million last week, marking nine consecutive trading days of net outflows. Looking at Farside’s daily breakdown, the aggregate figures were negative on all nine trading days from September 29 to October 9, with about $56.1 million flowing out on October 9; the disclosed negative figure that day was concentrated in ETHA. The weekly totals from the two sources differ due to rounding. “Nine days” refers to U.S. fund trading days, not nine calendar days, and certainly does not mean there were only sell orders across the entire ETH market for nine straight days.

What’s really worth watching in this story is when marginal fund flows turn positive, not just the headline total outflow. Net ETF share creations and redemptions can prompt issuers to adjust their underlying exposure, but they don’t capture all activity in on-chain spot markets, derivatives, or among global investors. U.S. markets are closed over the weekend, so funds have no new trading-day data. If ETH rebounds over the weekend, that only shows that traders in the immediate market are willing to buy; it doesn’t justify claiming that institutions have already returned. Outflows concentrated in one large fund last week also don’t mean holders of every product withdrew in unison. My next checkpoints are whether the breakdowns remain broadly in sync on the next U.S. trading day, and whether spot prices can hold their strength during that period.

As of writing, Kraken ETH/USD is around $2,499, with a daily open near $2,504 and a rolling 24-hour high of $2,516.65 and low of $2,490.86. The market has repeatedly contested the $2,500 level, but has yet to make a one-way breakout strong enough to overturn the weak fund-flow backdrop. Price moves also can’t simply be attributed to ETF creations and redemptions. Around $2,517 is the upside confirmation level, while around $2,491 is the downside warning level. If net fund flows turn positive on the next trading day and ETH holds above $2,517, I’ll revise my defensive view. If funds continue to see outflows and the price also loses $2,491, that would show that buying support still needs more testing. I won’t rush to a conclusion if only one of these conditions is met.

If I were trading this myself, I’d sit out for now. The only directional plan I’d keep is a conditional, small spot long position; I wouldn’t make a high-leverage bet. Only if ETH moves decisively above $2,517 and holds on a retest, with no new evidence of large fund outflows, would I use at most 4% of my total capital to try a long. My first target would be $2,560, where I’d sell half and move the stop on the rest up to around breakeven; my second target would be around $2,620, where I’d close the entire position. If the price falls back below $2,490 after entry, I’d exit at a loss. If it first breaks below $2,491, I’ll stay out and won’t describe an untriggered plan as an executed trade. My view is based on fund flows and price action moving together, not on the trending label itself.

#EtherETFsExtendOutflowsToNineDays #ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH基金连九个交易日净流出｜现价约2499美元｜我不把周末反弹当资金回流

我的态度是偏谨慎，先等资金与价格互相确认，不追2500美元附近的来回穿越。币安广场当前热门话题是#EtherETFsExtendOutflowsToNineDays。币安新闻引用SoSoValue称，美国现货以太坊基金上周净流出约5.421亿美元，连续九个交易日净流出。再看Farside逐日分项，9月29日至10月9日九个交易日合计栏均为负，10月9日约流出5610万美元，且当日披露的负值集中在ETHA。两处数据的周合计有四舍五入差异；“九日”说的是美国基金交易日，不是九个自然日，更不是ETH全市场连续九天只有卖单。

这则热点真正值得盯的是边际资金何时由负转正，而不只是流出总额的标题。ETF份额净申赎可以让发行方调整底层敞口，但它不能覆盖链上现货、衍生品和全球投资者全部行为。周末美股休市，基金没有新交易日数据；若ETH在周末反弹，最多说明即时交易盘愿意承接，不能据此宣称机构已经回流。上周流出集中在单一大基金，也不等于每只产品的持有人同步撤离。我的下一个观察点是美股下个交易日分项是否继续同向，以及现货能否在对应时段维持强度。

截至写稿，Kraken ETH/USD约2499美元，日开约2504美元，滚动24小时高2516.65、低2490.86。市场已经在2500一线反复争夺，却没有走出足以推翻资金偏弱背景的单边突破；价格波动也不能简单归因于ETF申赎。上方2517美元附近是确认位，下方2491美元附近是警戒位。若新交易日基金合计转正且ETH站稳2517，我会修正防守判断；若基金继续流出、价格又失守2491，则说明承接仍需更多检验。单独满足其中一项，我都不急着下结论。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只保留小仓现货多单的条件计划，不做高杠杆对赌。只有ETH有效站上2517美元并回踩不破，且没有新的基金大额流出证据，我才用总资金最多4%试多；第一目标2560美元，到位减半并把余仓止损抬至成本附近，第二目标2620美元附近全部平仓。入场后若跌回2490美元下方，止损平仓；若先失守2491，我保持空仓，不把未触发的计划写成成交。判断依据是资金和价格共振，不是热榜标签本身。

📰 Why Did a U.S. Fund Giant Suddenly Talk to the SEC About Blockchain Stocks?

Wells Fargo Funds quietly met with a special team at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on October 9 to discuss how U.S. stock funds could operate on a blockchain. Specifically, they discussed whether tokenized shares could be redeemed directly, whether market makers could charge fees, and how the Investment Company Act might apply to these new approaches. This is no small matter: it could mean the U.S. fund industry is gearing up for a major shift toward a closer integration of traditional finance and blockchain.

Why does this news matter?

The fact that an established fund company like Wells Fargo is getting directly involved shows that blockchain-based stocks aren’t just some small-scale experiment—they could become standard practice. Until now, U.S. funds have accessed crypto through ETFs. Trading directly on-chain could eliminate many intermediaries, lowering costs and boosting efficiency. Two major trends are driving this: investors are increasingly accepting digital assets, and Wall Street is vying for a share of the blockchain pie. If funds can buy and sell stocks directly on-chain, the gap between them and traditional stock markets will shrink considerably, posing a major challenge for regulators.

Market impact

There may not be much movement in the short term, since both Wells Fargo and the SEC are keeping things low-key. But over the medium to long term, if the U.S. develops standardized on-chain stock funds, that could be especially beneficial for ETH. Why? Because ETH has been working hard to attract institutional players since 2019, and now it could be put to use by giants like Wells Fargo. That said, keep in mind that these kinds of reforms usually take much longer than expected. The U.S. only approved Bitcoin ETFs last year, so it may be too early to expect on-chain stocks to take off. The key factor is the regulatory stance: if the SEC decides these products are too risky and pushes back, the entire industry will have to wait.

Trading strategy
💡 This could be a long-term positive for ETH, but in the short term, BTC and ETH prices are likely to remain volatile, driven by Federal Reserve liquidity. Key levels to watch are $80K for BTC and $2,300 for ETH. If these levels don’t hold, it suggests the market isn’t ready to embrace this new development. If XRP suddenly surges above $1.7, it could mean institutions are testing the potential demand for on-chain trading funds.

This view is invalidated if a large-scale bank run occurs in the U.S. If the price falls below $80K, the rationale no longer holds.

📰 为什么美国基金巨头突然和SEC聊区块链股票？

富国基金10月9号偷偷摸摸见了美国证券交易委员会专门小组，聊的是区块链上美国股票基金怎么搞。具体来说就是股票变成代币后能不能直接退、做市商收手续费、还有投资公司法怎么用这些新花样。这不是小事，意味着美国基金行业可能要搞个大动作，把传统金融和区块链结合得更紧。

为什么这条新闻重要？
富国这种老牌基金公司亲自下场，说明区块链股票这事儿不是小作坊的瞎折腾，而是要变成标准配置了。以前美国基金做加密都是走ETF通道，现在直接上链交易能省掉很多中间环节，成本更低效率更高。这背后是两个大趋势在推：第一是投资者越来越接受数字资产，第二是华尔街在抢区块链这块蛋糕。想想看，如果基金可以直接在链上买卖股票，那和传统股市的区别就小多了，对监管来说是个巨大考验。

对市场的影响
短期可能没太大动静，毕竟富国和SEC都是低调操作。但中长期看，如果美国搞出标准化的链上股票基金，对ETH帮助可能更大。为啥？因为ETH从2019年开始就拼命搞机构接入，现在正好被富国这种巨头用上。不过要注意，这种改革通常比预想的慢得多，去年美国才批准比特币ETF，现在说链上股票要起飞可能还为时过早。最关键的是监管态度，如果SEC觉得这种产品太危险会泼冷水，那整个行业又要等。

操作思路
💡 这事儿对ETH可能是个长期利好，但短期BTC和ETH价格大概率继续受美联储流动性影响波动。值得关注的价位是BTC $80K和ETH $2300，如果这两个关口没守住，说明市场根本没准备好接受这种新东西。如果XRP突然暴涨超过$1.7，说明机构在试探链上交易基金这块的潜在用量。

如果美国出现大规模银行挤兑，这个判断作废。跌破$80K这条逻辑就不成立。

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

截至北京时间十月十一日下午三点，以太坊现报价两千五百美元，过去二十四小时上涨百分之零点四四。价格在两千四百九十五美元附近获得买盘支撑后小幅反弹，盘中一度触及两千五百一十三美元，但整体仍维持在两千五百美元心理关口附近窄幅整理。

二、技术指标解读

从综合信号指标来看，当前十五个因子中有七个发出做多信号，七个发出做空信号，一个中性，多空力量几乎完全均衡。综合指标数值为零点二二三，略微偏向多头，历史胜率为百分之八十七点一，表明当前微弱的多头信号仍具有一定可靠性。

短期均线因子发出做空信号，RSI指标处于中性区间，说明市场暂时缺乏明确方向。不过alpha9、alpha17、alpha21、alpha25等多个因子指向多头，而alpha3、alpha7、alpha11等因子则偏空，反映出市场分歧较大。小时级别EMA七上穿EMA二十五形成短期金叉，MACD柱状图短暂转正，但九十九周期指数移动平均线两千五百三十三美元构成上方主要阻力，若无法有效突破则存在回落至两千四百八十美元支撑的风险。

三、市场情绪与资金面分析

资金面上，交易所现货持续呈现净流入状态，累计流入金额超过两亿美元，推动价格从两千四百九十五美元反弹至两千五百一十三美元。大户在过去一段时间内逢低吸纳超过十六万六千枚以太坊，对价格形成了有效的底部支撑。

然而风险因素同样显著。现货ETF市场已经连续九天净流出，累计赎回金额超过五亿四千万美元，创下今年一月以来最差单周表现。更值得警惕的是，美国现货以太坊ETF的做空敞口已经超过了做多敞口，表明机构投资者的看空情绪正在加剧。此外，部分早期大户向交易所转入了八千枚以太坊，短期内可能形成现货抛压。

从市场热点来看，Starknet的STRK代币二十四小时暴涨超过百分之四十，Layer2赛道重新获得资金关注。Aero与Velodrome宣布合并为跨链去中心化交易所，也带动了DeFi板块的情绪。这些结构性亮点为以太坊生态带来了一定的正面溢出效应。

综合来看，以太坊当前在两千五百美元关口展开拉锯。短期关注两千五百三十三美元的阻力突破情况，若放量突破则有望向两千六百美元进军；若受阻回落则需防范跌向两千四百八十美元的风险。建议投资者密切关注ETF资金流向变化以及大户链上行为，谨慎操作。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding: Fortune Through Risk, or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Compounding has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several-times leverage to ride a major trend, then roll it over a few times
and turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let's talk about what they don't tell you.

【What Compounding Actually Involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep opening trades,
It's essentially using the market's money to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding is astonishing; once it stops, those unrealized gains
can go from a few dozen points to zero in just one or two huge bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】The essence of compounding is “getting consecutive bets right.” If you have a 60% win rate, the odds of winning four times in a row
are only 13%. Those posts you see about doubling your money overnight are backed by 99 people who've already deleted their accounts.

title: 83K横着走，订单环境在分叉
subTitle:
83K横着走，订单环境在分叉

BTC 下午还在 83K 附近磨，表面看起来没什么方向：上方试探不远，下方回撤也不深，ETH 和 SOL 的波动同样不算夸张。很多人这时候会把注意力放在 K 线下一根怎么走，觉得只要方向判断没错，交易结果就差不到哪里去。
但横盘阶段最容易骗人的地方，恰恰是图上看不出差异。

同一张图、同一个交易对、同一个方向判断，最后成交出来可能是完全不同的两笔单。原因不一定在你看错了趋势，而在订单环境已经悄悄分叉：第一层报价够不够厚、目标数量会吃到第几层、点差有没有扩大、触发条件按什么价格走、进场和退出的承接是不是对称。
这些东西不会像一根大阴线那样醒目，但会直接改变你的实际成交价。

今天这种 83K 附近横着走的盘面，反而更适合看这件事。因为当价格大幅波动时，大家都会承认执行会变贵；可在表面平静的时候，很多人默认“差不多”。真正的问题就在这里：报价层不一定差不多，深度不一定差不多，规则也不一定差不多。
你看到的是同一个市场价格，订单穿过去的却是不同的路。

执行成本不是只有手续费。
如果一笔单的目标数量稍微大一点，第一档报价吃完后继续扫到更深层，成交均价就开始偏；如果进入时承接还行，退出时另一侧深度变薄，利润空间会被回吐；如果触发条件和标记价格有偏差，原本留给波动的风险缓冲会提前被消耗。
这些都不需要行情大幅变盘，只要报价层和规则有差异，结果就会慢慢偏离。

更麻烦的是，碎片化流动性会让交易者产生一种错觉：图是统一的，执行也是统一的。
现实不是这样。图表给你的是方向感，盘口给你的是可成交程度，规则给你的是这笔单真正会怎么落地。只看图，很容易把“我认为能成交的价格”误当成“我最终会拿到的价格”。

所以，横盘不是可以偷懒的时候。越是没方向，越要把下单前的比较做细：看点差，看深度，看目标数量吃到哪里，看触发条件，看退出时有没有足够承接。
这不是为了预测下一根 K 线，而是为了避免方向还没错，结果先被执行成本磨掉。

我现在更倾向于把 PerpEX 这类视角当成下单前的执行比较镜：先选资产，再比较不同交易场所的订单环境和成本结构，最后再决定这笔单从哪条路径走。开仓按钮很多，真正稀缺的是按下之前知道哪条路更不容易漂。

83K Trading Sideways, While Order Conditions Diverge

BTC was still hovering around 83K in the afternoon, with no clear direction on the surface: it didn’t probe far to the upside, and its pullbacks weren’t deep. ETH and SOL were similarly subdued. At times like this, many people focus on what the next candlestick will do, assuming that as long as they get the direction right, the trade’s result won’t differ much.
But the most deceptive thing about a sideways market is precisely that the differences aren’t visible on the chart.

The same chart, the same trading pair, and the same directional view can still result in two completely different trades. The reason isn’t necessarily that you misread the trend; it may be that the order environment has quietly diverged: how much depth is available at the top of the book, how many levels your target size will consume, whether the spread has widened, which price is used to trigger your conditions, and whether liquidity is equally available on entry and exit.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Wiping Out
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position—but how? Going all in from the start and adding everything once you’re in profit is a fast track to the liquidation list.
A regular. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After another confirmation, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping your average cost weighted toward the lower levels so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the opposite is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the highs. Even a small pullback can turn profits into losses; once you panic, your trading decisions fall apart.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why Being Able to Afford Losses Helps You Last Longer
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should be no more than 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
A 20% drawdown can be recovered with just a few winning trades. By contrast, if you go all-in each time and lose 30%,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly triple it to break even—mathematically, you’re pretty much done for.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
is no more than 2%.” So the right order is: find your stop-loss level → calculate the stop distance → work backward to determine your position size.

ETH back above 2,500 | Account abstraction: some features live, others still in development | Wait for fund flows to confirm before chasing the price

My stance is neutral to cautious: ETH hovering near $2,500 is worth monitoring, but a long-term development roadmap should not be directly translated into buying pressure today. The currently trending topic on Binance Square, #EthereumSurpasses2500USDT, is about price; what I want to know is whether, beyond the round number, the network is making itself easier for ordinary users to use. The Ethereum Foundation’s 2026 protocol priorities document is clear: Pectra brought EIP-7702 to mainnet in May 2025, allowing traditional externally owned accounts to temporarily execute smart contract logic and opening up possibilities for batch transactions, sponsored gas fees, and social recovery. Native account abstraction, EIP-7701, and EIP-8141, however, remain ongoing areas of development. The official account abstraction page also distinguishes the already-operational EIP-4337 smart contract account pathway from EIP-7702. We should not describe “smart accounts as the default, currently in development” as something that has already been fully implemented today.

Mechanically, the difficulty of recovering a wallet, having to pay gas fees in the native token for every operation, and repeatedly signing transactions across apps all add friction for new users. If account abstraction makes wallets easier to recover and transactions easier to bundle, it could improve app retention over the long term. At the same time, it introduces risks related to contract code, delegated permissions, and paymaster services, so users still need to check the scope of signatures and the entities receiving authorization. For ETH’s price, a better user experience first needs to translate into sustained usage, and then show up in on-chain activity, fee dynamics, or asset holdings. A roadmap document does not equal an equivalent inflow into spot ETH. In particular, US spot ETH fund flows are not cooperating right now: Farside’s table shows net outflows of approximately $56.1 million in total on October 9, with all of that day’s negative figure coming from ETHA. There are no new US stock-market fund trading sessions over the weekend, so a weekend spot rebound cannot be described as a fund flow reversal to net inflows.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,502.10, against a daily open of $2,504.10 and a rolling 24-hour high of $2,516.65 and low of $2,489.79. Although the price is above $2,500, it is slightly below the daily open and has not surpassed the 24-hour high. This looks more like a tussle around a round number than confirmation of an uptrend. I see $2,516.65 as the first level to clear, followed by $2,530. If $2,500 gives way, the first level to watch is $2,489.79. If the price spikes and then falls back below $2,516, that would invalidate the breakout thesis. If it breaks below $2,489.79 and rebounds weakly, the short-term bullish narrative should be dropped.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now, with only a small spot long position in mind. I would wait for a decisive move above $2,516.65, a successful retest, and clear signs that outflows have at least eased significantly on the next fund trading day before risking 2% of my total capital on a trial position. I would take half off at $2,530 and target $2,550 for the rest. The stop-loss would be below the retest low, with no more than 0.3% of account equity at risk on the trade. If the price moves back below $2,500 and remains weak, I would close the position proactively. If it first breaks below $2,489.79, I would cancel the long plan—no averaging down and no high leverage. If no trigger occurs, I am simply observing; no trade has been made and no profit has been earned.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。

translatedData.title: Scaling out: How to lock in profits while letting them run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because a stop loss cuts into your fear, while taking profit cuts into your greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here’s the scaling-out approach I’ve been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: when the price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell a third to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset changes immediately. Stage two: when it reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another third. Stage three: let a trailing stop manage the rest. Exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】Sell your entire position too early and you’ll kick yourself; hold everything and you’ll often ride the elevator all the way back to square one.
